title: Someone Put Ads Inside Claude Code And It Pays You
description:
A developer sold the loading spinner inside Claude Code to advertisers and shares the revenue with the people watching it. Twenty four thousand signed up. This short breaks down the real payout numbers pulled from the project's own public API, what the extension actually does to your machine, and the built-in ways to cut your Claude Code bill that work far better.

Covered: what the tool really is, the honest earnings math, why it is not worth installing, and the official Anthropic settings and commands that reduce your token spend.

Get the full guide here: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1MEVh8MvgeR4K7JPDJXLporveB6qsKM_OH2u5Pix7NdQ/edit?usp=sharing
